SEARCH
Package it.polimi.ingsw.view

Interface GameView

All Superinterfaces:
ReconnectableView
All Known Implementing Classes:
GameCLI, GameGUI
public interface GameView extends ReconnectableView
Contains all the headers of the methods used by both CLI and GUI during the actual gameplay.

  • Method Details

    • notifyLastTurn

      void notifyLastTurn()
      Shows a message indicating that the turn players are going to play next, will also be the last.

    • requestDraw

      void requestDraw(Map<CardType,List<BasicCard>> drawableCards, Map<CardType,Integer> numberOfCardsLeft)
      Requests a draw selection from the player. In order to let the player choose, this method also shows the list drawable cards.
      Parameters:
      drawableCards - the map linking a CardType to its drawable BasicCards.
      numberOfCardsLeft - the number of card left in each deck.
      See Also:
      • CardType
      • BasicCard

    • showChatMessage

      void showChatMessage(ChatMessage chatMessage)
      Shows the given received chat message.
      Parameters:
      chatMessage - the message properties: sender, recipients and message.
      See Also:
      • ChatMessage

    • requestPlacement

      void requestPlacement(List<CardSides> handCards, List<BasicCard> placedCards)
      Requests a placement selection from the player. In order to let the player choose, this method also shows the list of his hand front and back cards.
      Parameters:
      handCards - the list of CardSides representing the current player's hand. Each element represents a hand card.
      placedCards - the list of placed cards constituting the player's board.
      See Also:
      • CardSides
      • BasicCard

    • turnChanged

      void turnChanged(String turnOwner)
      Changes the current turn owner and notifies the player of that.
      Parameters:
      turnOwner - the nickname of the player who'll be the new turn owner.

    • showErrorMessage

      void showErrorMessage(String message)
      Shows the user that an error has occurred
      Parameters:
      message - the string containing the error message to show.

    • showUserJoined

      void showUserJoined(String nickname, Content color, boolean isGameFull)
      Notifies the player that a player has joined the game. This method runs in the lobby phase, before the starting of the game.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the newly joined player.
      color - the color of the newly joined player.
      isGameFull - the boolean that, if set true, lets also the game to start.
      See Also:
      • Content

    • updateRemotePlayerHand

      void updateRemotePlayerHand(String nickname, List<BasicCard> handCards)
      Updates a remote player hand. From the point of view of the local player, the hand cards of the opponents are composed only by back sides.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player on which the update is going to be done.
      handCards - the new hand cards of the specified remote player. This is a list of BasicCards.
      See Also:
      • BasicCard

    • updateLocalPlayerHand

      void updateLocalPlayerHand(List<CardSides> handCards)
      Updates the local player hand. Unlike the updateRemotePlayerHand method, this contains all the card sides of the player's hand.
      Parameters:
      handCards - the new hand cards of the local player. This is a list of CardSides.
      See Also:
      • CardSides

    • requestStarterSide

      void requestStarterSide(List<CardSides> playerCards)
      Requests a selection of the starter side (either front or back) from the player. In order to let the player choose, this method also shows each side of its starter card.
      Parameters:
      playerCards - the starting hand cards of the player. This is the only point in the game where the player has one more card than normal.
      See Also:
      • CardSides

    • updateBoard

      void updateBoard(String nickname, List<BasicCard> placedCards, int score)
      Updates the board of a specified player. The board, is a list of BasicCards which were previously chose by the player during the game proceedings. This method also updates the specified player score.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player whose board is going to be updated.
      placedCards - the list of placed cards of the specified player.
      score - the specified player's new score.
      See Also:
      • BasicCard

    • requestPersonalObjectivesChoice

      void requestPersonalObjectivesChoice(List<Objective> objectives)
      Requests the personal objective selection from the player. In order to let the player choose, this method also shows each of the objective to choose from.
      Parameters:
      objectives - the list of objectives from which the player has to choose one.
      See Also:
      • Objective

    • showPersonalObjectives

      void showPersonalObjectives(List<Objective> objectives)
      Shows the local player's personal objectives. These objectives are secret, and the opponents cannot se them.
      Parameters:
      objectives - the list of personal objectives of the local player.
      See Also:
      • Objective

    • showCommonObjectives

      void showCommonObjectives(List<Objective> objectives)
      Shows the local player's common objectives. These objective are shared with all the players.
      Parameters:
      objectives - the list of common objectives of the local player.
      See Also:
      • Objective

    • updateDecks

      void updateDecks(Map<CardType,List<BasicCard>> drawableCards, Map<CardType,Integer> numberOfCardsLeft)
      Updates the decks. These are intended as the currently drawable cards, not the entire decks.
      Parameters:
      drawableCards - the map linking a CardType to its drawable BasicCards.
      numberOfCardsLeft - the number of card left in each deck.
      See Also:
      • CardType
      • BasicCard

    • revealFinalSummary

      void revealFinalSummary(String nickname, Map<Objective,Integer> objectivePoints, int finalScore)
      Reveals the final game summary of one player, which includes their score for each objective and their final total score.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player on which the summary is based.
      objectivePoints - the map linking each objective to its point gained-by value.
      finalScore - the player's score.
      See Also:
      • Objective

    • revealWinners

      void revealWinners(List<String> winners)
      Reveals the winners of the game, showing their names (and summaries).
      Parameters:
      winners - the list of winners' nicknames.

    • notifyRemotePlayerDisconnected

      void notifyRemotePlayerDisconnected(String nickname, Content color, boolean quiet)
      Notifies a remote player disconnection, by showing a message.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the disconnected player's nickname.
      color - the disconnected player's color.
      quiet - the boolean flagging whether the disconnection must be quiet or not.
      See Also:
      • Content

    • notifyPlayerLeftLobby

      void notifyPlayerLeftLobby(String nickname, Content color)
      Notifies that a player has left the lobby, by showing a message.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of whom left the lobby.
      color - the color of whom left the lobby.
      See Also:
      • Content

    • notifyRemotePlayerReconnected

      void notifyRemotePlayerReconnected(String nickname)
      Notifies a remote player reconnection, by showing a message. This occurs when server detected that a previously disconnected player has now reestablished a connection.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the disconnected player's nickname.

    • notifyGameTimeout

      void notifyGameTimeout()
      Notifies that the game has now an aborting timer going on, by showing a message. If enough time passes, the game will automatically be aborted by the server.

    • notifyTurnSkipped

      void notifyTurnSkipped()
      Notifies that a player's turn has been skipped, by showing a message. This occurs when the turn is passed to a currently disconnected player.

    • showNoMovesAvailable

      void showNoMovesAvailable(String nickname)
      Shows that a player has no more moves available. This implies that the player is currently stuck in his state.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the stuck player's nickname.
